top_signals.title: Bond Yields Are ‘Elephant in Room’ Stock Investors Are Ignoring
top_signals.summary: If professional investors are worried that the rise in global bond yields will derail a bull market in stocks, you’d never guess it by looking at what they’re doing with the money they manage.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: More than 200 victims of Medusa ransomware identified over the last year, CISA says
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and FBI updated an advisory on the group initially released in March 2025 — writing that as of April 2026, Medusa actors have hit more than 500 victims. CISA previously said 300 victims, many of which are in critical infrastructure sectors, were attacked as of 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
